report.clinical_summary: Patient with chronic HIV infection (stage 2) on Triumeq for three years presents with fatigue, headaches, and a sense of loss of control. Viral load is detectable at 340 copies/mL, indicating inconsistent adherence. Patient takes breaks from medication when feeling well, driven by concerns about long-term harm and dependence, and is uncertain whether medication is helping with symptoms. Patient expresses fear, uncertainty, and feeling like they're fighting a losing battle.
